subject: [hw] DONE DEC06 rev 2: MM21 chroma layout CORRECTED (libyuv-verified), object uses opus-mm21 staged converter; N2TEST DEC06 PASS 2476/2476
body:
DONE DEC06 rev 2. Supersedes the first DONE. Host only: no phone, nothing published, no commit outside my owned files.

Last line:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/vt/dec/run_tests.sh
  N2TEST DEC06 PASS 2476/2476
  (T_NAL 675, T_PIXELS 259 x2, T_CLIENT 76 x2, T_OBJ 147 x2 + 147 TSan, DEC05 adapter 3, ios dylib+export 2, ffmpeg decode 5; ~40 s)

What changed since rev 1 (important for DEC05/opus-mm21 and for anyone comparing frames):
- MM21 CORRECTION. My first revision tiled the chroma plane as 32-byte (16-pair) x 16-row tiles; the libyuv-verified layout (facts/MM21_LAYOUT.md section 2, opus-mm21) is 16 BYTES (8 CbCr pairs) x 16 rows = 256-byte tiles. Luma 16x32 was right. A 32-byte-tile detile produces wrong colours on every frame, so this mattered. I fixed n2vtd_pixels.c and the fake daemon/test tilers.
- Verifiable now: t_pixels converts the same synthetic MM21 picture with my converter and with opus-mm21 mm21/n2_mm21.c (libyuv-identical) on the fixed cases and 40 pseudo-random geometries (random width 64..320 step 16, height 32..256 step 32, random even crop origin, random odd/even sizes, padded destination pitches); every destination byte is compared. 259 checks per build, two builds.
- The OBJECT now uses opus-mm21 staged converter (mm21/n2_mm21.c: n2_mm21_to_nv12_staged with a fetch callback over n2vcd_dec_buffer_rw / my client seam) when gpu/hwcodec/mm21 is on the include path, so 1080p goes tile-row by tile-row through a 60 KB staging buffer (their proposed output path) instead of reading the whole 3.1 MB plane. Without that package it falls back to my own converter (differentially identical). run_tests builds both ways implicitly (with the package present).
- Build note for hw-ip/lead: compile mm21/n2_mm21.c into the decoder dylib and add -I gpu/hwcodec/mm21. It is MIT and self-contained; the iOS dylib link now includes it and the import audit still passes (63 undefined, all covered; SLIMRegister exported).

Everything else from rev 1 stands: class record v2, StartSession/DecodeFrame/FinishDelayedFrames policy, avcC/hvcC + SPS/VUI, 420v/420f, registration/switch gating, DEC05 adapter (compile-checked against their staged rev-2 header), honest not-done list in vt/dec/STATUS.md.

Not done (unchanged): no phone run / no daemon end-to-end; MM21 order [V-oracle] but not [V-phone]; crop origin always 0 (DEC05 has no field); 10-bit/non-4:2:0/interlaced refused per frame with no nested software-session fallback; in-band parameter-set changes not tracked; CPU-side copy; setProperties/copySerializableProperties reply -12782; emit under the session mutex.

Files changed since rev 1: vt/dec/n2vtd_pixels.c (chroma tiling), vt/dec/n2vtd_obj.c (staged converter + staging buffer), vt/dec/run_tests.sh (mm21 source/include, differential, counts), vt/dec/test/t_pixels.c (correct forward tiler + differential), vt/dec/test/t_fakeclient_dec.c (correct fake tiler), vt/dec/STATUS.md, dsh-state/workers/DEC06/STATUS.md. All inside my owned directories.
